name: How much does a custom door installation cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a custom door installation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of custom door installation depends on several factors, including the type of door, materials chosen, complexity of the design, hardware selections, and any necessary structural modifications to the existing opening. Generally, custom doors are an investment due to their unique specifications and higher quality materials compared to standard off-the-shelf options. For instance, a custom-sized, energy-efficient fiberglass entry door with decorative glass will typically cost more than a plain custom interior door. We provide a detailed, itemized estimate after a thorough on-site consultation to ensure all aspects of your project are captured.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom door costs vary based on door type, materials, design complexity, hardware, and structural modifications.
